host.label: Computer address
host.description: IP address or hostname of the computer running Glances

port.label: Glances port
port.description: Port of the Glances web server (glances -w listens on 61208)

interval_ms.label: Sample interval, ms
interval_ms.description: Time between samples. One sample is one column of the graph. Glances refreshes its REST API about every 2 seconds, so a shorter interval repeats samples
